title: freight invoice audit: before and after

before.label: today: manual
before.total: ≈ 8 min of staff time per invoice (blended)

steps.task: Sort invoices from the AP inbox, carrier portals and the EDI exception report
Find the shipment and rate confirmation in the TMS
Check base rate, fuel surcharge and accessorials against the contract or tariff
Pull the POD and BOL; check weight, class, detention times and delivery date
Search the ERP for a duplicate by PRO number, amount and date
Research overcharges, email the carrier, chase the credit memo
Code to GL and cost centre, key the voucher into the ERP
Review and release the weekly payment run

after.label: agent workflow
after.total: ≈ 0.7 min of human time per invoice (blended)

steps.task: Parse EDI 210s and portal CSVs; OCR PDFs from the AP inbox
Tag each PDF by carrier, mode and document type; route statements and PODs
Turn PDF invoices into structured line items with page citations
Match to shipment, re-rate from rate tables and fuel index, check POD and duplicates
Rule on accessorials and tariff clauses the rate tables cannot settle
Draft the carrier dispute with the evidence pack attached
Approve disputes over $250 and low-confidence exceptions
Code from shipment data, short-pay disputed lines, build the payment file
Approve the payment run before it goes to the bank
